name: Rizuhble's Friendly Fire Harrow
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Leech Therapy T3, Lurking Terrors unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power. Ultimate (Lurking Terrors) is available from Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 1.9 per second to Leech Therapy's damage per second (0.19x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Surge of Power completes 4.8k spirit in 8000 souls (~8.0 min), 7 purchases

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Debuff Reducer, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Debuff Reducer, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Burst Fire, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Wretched Vapors: takes 18% off its 40s base cooldown.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Healing Needles: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +5.6 per second on its heal regen (0.20x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-27,200 (levels 15-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Wretched Vapors T3, Healing Needles T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Burst Fire, vitality 4.8k at Debuff Reducer.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Debuff Reducer completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Debuff Reducer completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. | +18 spirit adds about 8.8 per second to Leech Therapy's damage per second (0.49x scaling).

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | With 3 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 245s; 20% off is 49s per full rotation.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus. | Temporary, sold when you buy Ricochet later.
items.legacy_note: Barrier and speed on a teammate, half cooldown on them. Sell it for Ricochet.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 14.7 per second to Leech Therapy's damage per second (0.49x scaling).

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-60,800 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lurking Terrors T3.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it right before your ult.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it on the needles (3), swap back. Each use adds ammo past your mag.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal. Procs when you heal teammates.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Your healing needles bounce to more teammates too. Sell Guardian Ward for this.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Boundless Spirit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Toxic Bullets.
sections.desc: Dying after Boundless Spirit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Wretched Vapors: resets its 25s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Burst Fire: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Wretched Vapors. Sell Burst Fire for this.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Healing Needles: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Titanic Magazine: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Healing Needles. Sell Titanic Magazine for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Toxic Bullets for this. If you bought Dispel Magic, sell that instead.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 195s of base cooldown across your kit, 150s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Escalating Exposure: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
